scope.assignment_amendment: Coordinator reassigned pages 257–512 to the middle-page reviewer after early contact inspection had reached 448. Required acceptance here is limited to pages 1–256.
scope.limits: Visual assembly acceptance only. Detailed unchanged source glyphs and content inherit the individually accepted standalone pages through exact current raster equality. Semantic index accuracy, click destinations, source-language correctness and full-volume acceptance are separate reviews.

method.retained_header_body_comparison: System.Drawing without color management decodes every raster to top-down RGB8; exact channel-byte equality above the footer, with SHA-256 receipts and mismatch pixel bounds. PNG-filter prefix hashes are an independent sufficient equality check, not the final comparison criterion.

footer_exclusion.guard_expectation: Every RGB channel is 255 in the full-width blank gap around the cutoff.

method.whole_page_inspection: Every assigned page was personally observed in labelled reduced whole-page contact sheets at original sheet resolution. Inspected page sequence, margins, running heads, table continuations, clipping, collisions, component transitions and unexpected blank content.
method.folio_inspection: Every assigned footer was personally observed in native-pixel folio-strip sheets. Read each numeral against the labelled physical page and expected PDF folio; checked the unprinted title folio and five intentional blanks.
method.new_page_inspection: All twelve front-matter pages and all five intentional blank pages in the assigned range were opened individually as native raw full-page rasters with detail=original. These exact raw images belong to the final combined render manifest; their hashes were independently revalidated.
method.supplementary_inspection: Before the assignment was narrowed, contacts for pages 257–448 and native blank page 466 had also been viewed. Folio sheet 11 additionally exposed pages 257–264. These remain supplementary observations and do not extend required acceptance beyond page 256.
method.full_size_proof_copy_note: Native full-page views used the raw combined PNGs, not the re-encoded learner-page proof copies. Both byte hashes are recorded separately; the final proof manifest reports native-pixel equivalence. No byte identity is claimed between differently encoded PNGs.
method.preservation_basis: All 239 retained pages within the assigned range match the accepted standalone header/body RGB pixels through row 1327 inclusive. The full-width 224–226 mm guard band is white in both rasters; no body text is hidden by footer exclusion. Actual source PDF hashes and their visual acceptance receipts were checked.
method.limits: The contact sheets are structural overviews, not a fresh word-by-word reading of all retained learner text. No claim is made that all 256 source bodies were reopened at native size; full-size body inspection here covers new front matter and blanks. Navigation and linguistic reviews remain separate.

validation.equivalent_full_size_pixel_equality_basi: native_pixels_verified in the final proof manifest; raw PNGs and re-encoded full-size proof PNGs have distinct byte hashes

observations.note: Title, volume explanation and complete contents are readable. Roman folios ii–xii agree with the expected labels; no folio is printed on the title page.
Pronunciation and Units 1–8, followed by the first twelve standalone pages of Unit 9, appear in order with preserved running heads, complete table panels, clear continuations and intact margins.
Each was inspected natively and is entirely blank, including the footer. Numbering resumes at the expected following odd folio.

viewed_full_size_native_pages.note: Unit 2 contents heading falls at page bottom with complete page number; its subsections continue on page iv. Known nonblocking contents split.

optional_findings.finding: The Unit 2 contents heading and its complete page number 37 occupy the foot of page iii; the subsection list begins on page iv.
optional_findings.disposition: Accepted as the previously noted nonblocking contents break. The heading and locator are complete, and the continuation is clear; no revision is required for this acceptance.

conclusion: Accepted for physical learner pages 1–256 of the exact 971-page PDF identified above. No material visual defect remains in this assigned range.
